# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| main    | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

This is the canonical repository for CMES-AI (maintained by Techies Without Borders).

**Please report security vulnerabilities here**, in this repository.

This system is **not validated for clinical decision-making**. See the CRITICAL SAFETY NOTICE in this README and `SAFETY.md` before any use.
